text:
sam: incident-bot just fired a P1 for inference-frontend - high 5xx spike from west1 at 17:20. paging now.
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert -> P1: inference-frontend - 5xx spike. Runbook: https://redwood-internal/runbooks/inference-5xx. Assigned: eng-oncall.
sam: i’m ending my shift in ~20m. can someone take primary driver? i’m in transit after 17:45, might be slow to respond.
priya: i can pick up driver for the next hour. will take comms if needed. @devon do you want to be secondary?
devon: i’ll stay secondary for today. if this needs infra escalation pls loop in @elaine.
elaine: on call for infra next 2 hrs. will watch metrics and be ready for a rollback if the canary is the problem.
sam: thanks. assigning in PD now: 
```
# quick pd assign
pd assign inference-frontend primary priya
pd add-note inference-frontend "sam -> priya handoff; sam offline at 17:45"
```
ops-bot: note: PD assignment complete. Primary: priya. Secondary: devon.
priya: quick status: 5xx originates from /v1/generate path, error rate concentrated on requests > 2k tokens. latency also up. looks like batching/kvcache thrash.
devon: good signal. tagging the runtime team: @elaine check GPU memory pressure? also any recent kernel changes?
elaine: no kernel pushes in last 6 hrs. seeing elevated mem allocs on a few pods - possible cache eviction storm. snapshot of pod logs: 
```
2026-03-12T17:21:05Z inference-frontend-7f8c9 pod: kvcache: evicting prefix 0x3f.. due to mempressure
2026-03-12T17:21:07Z inference-frontend-7f8c9 pod: batcher: flush abnormally large batch (size=48)
2026-03-12T17:21:09Z model-server-2 pod: oom-killer invoked for process reroute
```
priya: ok plan: 1) short-term: reduce max batch size to 16 for west1 route, 2) enable fallback to quantized-variant q4 for the heavy seq path, 3) notify customers via status page if we need >15m mitigation.
sam: runbook pointer: follow "driver-handoff-and-mitigation" section in the runbook (https://redwood-internal/runbooks/inference-5xx#handoff). Steps 1-3 are in there.
devon: i can push the batching change and watch queues. priya can coordinate comms and rollback if needed.
priya: doing batching change now, will post the helm diff.
priya: helm diff: 
```yaml
- batcher:
-   maxBatchSize: 48
+ batcher:
+   maxBatchSize: 16
```
priya: helm upgrade --namespace inference inference-frontend -f override-west1.yaml --set batcher.maxBatchSize=16
ops-bot: deploy started: rollout inference-frontend/west1 override-west1 (triggered by priya).
priya: deploy is at 30s, watch for error rates to drop.
elaine: watching GPU metrics - memory pressure falling on two pods already.
devon: seeing p95 latency drop from 1.6s -> 1.05s in the west1 metric stream. error rate down to ~2% from 22%.
priya: good. keeping primary until sam signs off. sam: can you confirm handoff complete before you go offline?
sam: confirmed. priya driving, devon comms secondary, elaine infra. leaving bridge and contact list in thread. 
sam: contact list: priya (primary driver) +1, devon (comms) +1, elaine (infra) pager oncall.
priya: i’ll keep the status page updated. if error rate creeps back above 10% we failover to quantized-variant and open a postmortem.
devon: noted. updating internal incident tracker: short-term mitigation applied, followup: investigate kvcache sizing and batcher heuristics.
priya: final check: anyone seeing customer-impact messages in support?
elain: (typo) i meant no, but i’ll check.
elaine: support slack: one spike ticket from acct-team; i flagged it to priya.
priya: thanks. sam: enjoy the offline time. i’ll escalate if anything changes.
sam: thanks team. handing off. :wave: 
priya: closing this handoff note: primary driver = priya, comms = devon, infra escalation = elaine. coverage gap resolved by immediate batching change. leaving follow-ups in the runbook checklist. :thumbsup:
